cases.answer: A threshold transaction report (TTR) must be submitted when a reporting entity provides a designated service involving the transfer of physical currency (cash) of AUD 10,000 or more, or the foreign currency equivalent. [2] Structuring means deliberately splitting cash transactions into amounts below AUD 10,000, or otherwise arranging transactions, so that a threshold transaction report is avoided. [3]

A suspicious matter report (SMR) must be submitted when a reporting entity forms a suspicion on reasonable grounds that a customer is not who they claim to be, or that a transaction or activity may be related to money laundering, terrorism financing, tax evasion, the proceeds of crime or another serious offence. [1] A suspicious matter report (SMR) must be submitted to AUSTRAC within 3 business days after the reporting entity forms the suspicion. [2]
